title: UCF x UF Showmatch
body: Tune in and watch Esports at UCF and UF Esports go head to head to figure out who is best! 5 different titles, only 1 champion. Who will come out on top?
imageAlt: UCF Knight and UF gator going head to head. August 29th 2:00pm EST. 5 games: Valorant, Rocket league, Overwatch, Rainbow six, and Marvel Rivals. Live on twitch.tv/esportsatucf and twitch.tv/gator_esports.
